PRIVATE.description: Retain private exact archive/current HTTP and original fixed-window analytics receipts; later queries stay separate; no raw private data in GitHub.

BROWSER.description: Inspect actual sequential exact-archive calibration/routes and real-SDK evidence, all predefined trials/errors/trace identities. Native Windows/macOS T01 stays pending unless observed. Unavailable/blocked/partial is not pass; no historical RCA inferred from lab success.

REVIEW.description: Separate non-implementing reviewer subagent inspects actual code, issue intent/ACs, raw and sanitized evidence, privacy, CS01/04/05/07/08/09/10, limitations and corrections. Source/green CI is not independent or performance acceptance.

LIVE.description: Verify exact issue/PR/source/check links and reconcile whole-criterion checkbox status. No production remediation or deployment authorized.

MERGED.description: Maintainer merge decision and accepted-source/main verification before closing tooling delivery. Investigation issue can remain open while real-session cause is unresolved.

SECOND-WAVE.description: Inspect all9 CPU/DPR trials and3 cold/reload/reopen sessions, immutable inputs, recorded CPU command and actual Canvas/DPR/adaptive state, fresh documents, critical portrait/CSS/engine cache evidence corroborated by Timing/CDP/server ledger, all failed/unexecuted cases and trace identities. Loopback headers/SDK-ineligible behavior, simulation and historical-cause limits must remain explicit; no source test substitutes for these observations.

NATIVE-HANDOFF.description: Independently inspect ordinary access failure/source receipts, actual Chrome recording/HAR/blocking instructions and post-load export behavior, exact-session/source checks, zero forwarded test telemetry and honest missing startup/native/SDK limits. Preparation can complete AC11; actual native slow-session/SDK evidence remains separately pending under AC06/AC07.
